title: 3.1.0.2-dev-a (and older 3.0.0.2 dev versions going back a couple of months) - User Action button coloring
body:
We recently started using a User Action automation to add a specific Note at the click of a button. (my daughter started a medication that needs to be taken at least 30 minutes before breakfast, so wanted to keep track of exact timing)
Medication was started around June 1st. From the start this User Action button showed up bright blue with a green icon on it, but no visible name. due to an error on my part when trying to install dev-n, I accidentally ended up with dev-g instead (used the wrong project in Android Studion). With dev-g, the User Action button shows up in a dark grey color, with a blue name corresponding to the Automation name, and the same green icon. This looks much more like how the button is supposed to look, so I suspect the "blue button" is due to an error somewhere in the code related to implementing light/dark mode styles.
